theme: An open day sitting under a stack of trip prep.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — nothing scheduled between you and the Croatia to-do list. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and tomorrow's passport window is the thing quietly setting the clock.

needsAttention.title: Passport packet due before Thursday
needsAttention.detail: The four girls' passport appointment is Thursday. The DS-11s still need printing and get signed at the counter, and it takes two separate payments — a State Dept check (~$400, no cards) and USPS (~$200). One missing document sends all four applications home.

needsAttention.title: Checked bags on the Croatia ticket aren't confirmed
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on a codeshare operated by Eurowings Discover. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's own site with the record locator and confirm the allowance before airport-counter fees. Overdue since Monday.

needsAttention.title: Two St. Pete nights are still open
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20–21 — the gap between landing from Croatia and Tuesday's kid pickup — still needs a room before the Orlando villa. Overdue since Monday; a car rental already spans the whole run.

flagged.title: Tokyo board contacts wrote back
flagged.detail: Furuta at JOMON and Sakai's office at ProNed both replied warmly to your possible week-of-Sept-30 Tokyo visit — no ask, they'll flag introductions if any come up.

flagged.title: Nautilus final payment is due
flagged.detail: The sailing school invoiced the $6,475 balance for the September course; payment is due.

flagged.title: Kuala Lumpur invite from CGI
flagged.detail: Kerrie Waring asked if you'd like to come along to meet a new corporate audience — speaker slots are filled, but the room may be worth it.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel confirmations — the St. Pete Airbnb, the Enterprise rental, sailing materials shipped — plus a home-policy renewal notice.

recipe.title: Sauteed zucchini with scallions & fresh mozzarella
recipe.why: High summer means zucchini and scallions are at their peak, so this is a quick way to cook the garden's glut.

tasks.title: Book the Cavtat hotel and noon transfer for Sept 19

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the morning is entirely yours.
Still open; the overdue Croatia bookings are the only thing pulling at the day.
Tomorrow brings the passport window before Thursday and a noon call with Martin at Valoris.
